text:
mike_sales: Kicking off CobaltTrust POC thread. Need firm answers on SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, domain verification, and a committed Dedicated estimate. Finance wants SOW language + security QA before budget.

anya_se: Quick asks from eng: IdP metadata (XML/URL), SP vs IdP-initiated, NameID format, SCIM auth choice (bearer token vs mTLS), list of domains for DNS validation, and whether you need per-route RBAC.

client_it_cobalt: We prefer SP-initiated, NameID=email. SCIM: token OK for POC, will evaluate mTLS for prod. Domains: cobalttrust.com, eu.cobalttrust.com, partners.cobalttrust.com. We want group->role mapping and tenant isolation for routes.

leo_ts: Noted. For domain delegation: org-level claim covering subdomains is possible but requires a TXT on the parent and explicit consent from partners. That can add 2-5 business days per external domain.

ruth_security: Security highlights: 1) POC: bearer token ok, prod: recommend mTLS. 2) Audit logs default 90d; enterprise 365d option (pricing delta). 3) SAML cert rotation supported; add to SOW. 4) Need completed security questionnaire and contact for compliance.

anya_se: SCIM test payload we'll use for POC provisioning (smoke):
```json
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"],
  "Resources":[{
    "id":"u-501","userName":"s.jones@cobalttrust.com","externalId":"ct|501","emails":[{"value":"s.jones@cobalttrust.com"}],
    "groups":["trading","ops"]
  }]
}
```
Mapping: trading->trade-analyst, ops->ops-operator. Initial SCIM rate-limit 50 req/min.

mike_sales: Pricing ask: committed Dedicated estimate for 150 req/s sustained, ~1.5M tokens/day. Need reserved monthly + overage, 24/7 support, EU data residency, and note on per-route RBAC premium. Leo, can you draft estimate and call out onboarding delta for domain delegation?

leo_ts: Will do. I'll include reserved GPU pool monthly, per-1k token overage, support add-on, 90->365d log uplift, and a per-external-domain onboarding line item. Also note quantized-model caveat and potential higher commit for tight latency SLOs.

olivia_legal: Legal needs a short SOW clause for SSO/SCIM (cert rotation, metadata exchange, provisioning termination, data residency). I'll attach a brief template.

ruth_security: I'll fill the security QA within 24h. Reminder: enabling per-route logging or tenant-scoped KMS will increase scope and cost.

integrationbot: Deploy queued: feature/cobalt-identity-poc -> staging at 2024-11-20T04:00Z :rocket:

mike_sales: Action items: client to send metadata + SCIM token + group list today; Leo to send estimate; Olivia to post SOW snippet; Ruth to complete QA. Sync in 24h. :thumbsup:
